Roojoom enables goal-driven customer journeys for large service providers. Drive your goals by joining the journey company!

View all openings

Roojoom helps service providers improve their customers’ experience and increase customer satisfaction, while promoting the service provider’s business goals. Customer Journey is the overall sum of experiences a customer has with a service provider – using the service, visiting the website and apps, getting support etc. Our customer journey management platform drives millions of personalized customer journeys in deployments around the world.

Life in Roojoom is demanding, as we rely on our team to fulfill our potential – our future is in our own hands! We have already been recognized as a high-potential startup company and completed several rounds of investment. Our portfolio includes large business partners and leading global enterprise customers.

We are growing fast and are looking for excellent people to join our team!

IS ROOJOOM THE COMPANY FOR YOU?

If you prefer to blaze your own trail rather than being micromanaged, Roojoom is the right place for you. We employ a flat management structure and responsibilities are up for grabs. We expect our team members to take initiative, demonstrate accountability and lead the way. If you initiate a project, you are very likely to receive ownership on it from the get go. You will also find we are very open to adopt improvements and best-practices our team members come up with or have experienced in other working places. And if you have personal needs or requests, we will do our best to accommodate those as well. Our goal is to enable you to perform your best work while also loving your job! Last but not least, Roojoom makes it a point to employ only the kind people who are fun to work with. So, if you are excited about joining a small no-politics company on its road to success and appreciate the opportunity to make a real impact on a daily basis, your place is definitely with us.
